I posted the draft bullets for June as a reply to your message in #coastal-team. Nothing has been sent to June.

The bullets cover:
- The 16 Feb rename from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living.
- The saved report that still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", from Moss's 18 May coverage digest.
- The clash with Pellucid Harbor Logistics, which also goes by PHL.
- Moss's cheat sheet, which still lists the account under the old name.
- Ticket PD-4821 as a related open item.
- A request that June confirm which name and code to use, and who owns the clean-up.

The digest is from 18 May, so I can't confirm the report still has the old label today. I'd check that before the note goes to June.
